meta.name: write-task-todo
meta.description: Use after task analysis when a non-trivial Formax repository task needs a structured `docs/todolist.md` with [x]/[ ] items, definitions-before-UI ordering, explicit non-goals, tests, and loop-ready execution slices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为复杂仓库任务生成结构化待办清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码仓库中按规范组织开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured todo lists for complex repository tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize development tasks in a code repository with structured checklists

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会根据任务分析生成一份结构化的待办清单文件（docs/todolist.md），包含定义、非目标、测试和可独立执行的循环，并优先定义接口和数据模型再实现UI。
howto.when: 在完成任务分析并讨论对齐后，当任务需要多个实现循环、提交、审查或跨层协调时触发。

say.text: 请为这个新功能生成待办清单。
say.note: Claude会创建包含完整结构的todolist.md。

say.text: 分析完任务后，给我一个带执行循环的todo。
say.note: 会生成带Loop Contract和review项的清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a structured todo file (docs/todolist.md) from task analysis, including definitions, non-goals, tests, and independent execution slices, with definitions before UI.
howto.when_en: Triggered after task analysis is discussed and aligned, when the task is large enough to need multiple implementation loops, commits, reviews, or cross-layer coordination.

say_en.text: Generate a todo list for this feature.
After analysis, give me an execution-ready todo.
say_en.note: Includes Loop Contract and review items.
